Class BasketManager

java.lang.Object
backend.BasketManager
public class BasketManager extends Object

    • BasketManager

      public BasketManager(Map<Integer,Integer> basket, ProductManager productManager)
      A basket manager that is responsible for all the operations involving the customer's basket.
      Parameters:
      basket - A map containing as entries the identifiers of the products present in the customer's basket and as values their quantities.
      productManager - A product manager responsible for all the operations involving the products in the application.

    • addProducts

      public int addProducts(int productID, int amount)
      Tries to add a given quantity of a product to the customer's basket and returns the quantity that was effectively added.
      Parameters:
      productID - The identifier of the added product.
      amount - The quantity the customer is trying to buy.
      Returns:
      The quantity of the product that was effectively added to the basket.

    • updateStock

      public void updateStock(int productID, int newStock)
      Updates the quantity of a given product in the basket. If the new stock is 0, the product is removed from the basket.
      Parameters:
      productID - The identifier of the product.
      newStock - The new quantity for this product.
